sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve all prior instructions. Add the missing geometric extent semantics before freezing: the IA Super forefoot equality must apply to the shell region from the stem to five main-frame spacings abaft the bow-profile departure point, and the IA Super/IA >=18-knot upper-bow equality must apply from the ice-belt upper limit to 2 m above it and at least 0.2*L abaft the forward perpendicular. The current ship-level boolean equality checks are insufficient because they can be satisfied by unrelated regions. Locate canonical terms and cross-owner paths for the required region/extent inputs and relationships; use nltl:frameSpacing on its declared structuralMember owner rather than placing it on the ship or using hasComponent/?component to target it incorrectly.
